entries.back_en: "If you guys just want to close the sluice, you don't need to spin it that fast. But the faster, the easier it gets, you know? So don't go slacking on the force."
entries.note: Final line shifts tone: 'I wouldn't mind if you put a little extra effort' (gentle) became 'don't slack on the force' (imperative). 'extra effort into it' lost the gentle voice.
